vedic_reference.note: The name Sharomani is derived from two Sanskrit words: Shri (Goddess of Wealth) and Ruchi (Taste, Pleasure). It is a name that signifies abundance, prosperity, and pleasure. In Hindu mythology, Shri is often depicted as the goddess of wealth and abundance, while Ruchi represents the taste and pleasure that comes with having wealth and prosperity.
